display.purpose: Numerals and the hero greeting only — never body copy.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked labels, kickers, severity tags.

shadows.name: ambient-soft
shadows.purpose: Featured status cards only (e.g. weekly-health ring card).

shadows.name: ambient-float
shadows.purpose: Floating chrome — the pill tab bar and bottom sheets.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Brass gold action; pressed dims and compresses slightly.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #C9A050; color: #0A1020; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px 20px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; transition: opacity .15s, transform .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: .92; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: .88; transform: scale(.985); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .45; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action; fills Slate Surface on press.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #E9EDF7; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 20px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: #131F42; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Filter pill; active state flips to brass.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: #0D1730; color: #E9EDF7; border: 1px solid #1B2748; border-radius: 999px; padding: 12px 14px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip-active { background: #C9A050; border-color: #C9A050; color: #0A1020; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Slate well; gold border on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #131F42; color: #E9EDF7; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus { background: #0D1730; border-color: #C9A050; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7E8AAB; }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: Navy surface, generous radius; hairline row dividers inside.
components.html:
Weekly health
18 of 24 reports in
components.css: .ds-card { background: #0D1730; border-radius: 24px; padding: 16px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; color: #E9EDF7; } .ds-card-row { padding: 12px 0; font-size: 15px; } .ds-card-row-div { border-top: 1px solid #141E3D; }

components.name: Severity Tag
components.description: Uppercase tracked label on a soft semantic wash.
components.css: .ds-tag { border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 10px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tag-warn { color: #FCD34D; background: rgba(217,119,6,.2); } .ds-tag-urgent { color: #FCA5A5; background: rgba(220,38,38,.18); }

components.name: Floating Tab Bar
components.description: Glassy navy pill floating over content; active item is a brass pill.
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: flex; gap: 4px; align-items: center; background: rgba(22,36,75,.9); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(4,8,26,.6); width: max-content; } .ds-tab { padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 999px; color: #7E8AAB; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tab-active { background: #C9A050; color: #0A1020; }

narrative.overview: A boardroom briefing delivered after dark: a deep midnight field, quiet typographic columns, and a single brass voice that speaks only when it matters. Status is carried by typography and hairlines before color; gold marks the active tab, the coverage ring, and the call to action. Dense but never loud — every screen reads in seconds.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed deep navy with tonal layering instead of shadows
One accent (brass gold) at ≤10% of any screen
Fraunces serif reserved for numerals and the greeting
Uppercase tracked overlines and hairlines instead of boxes and icons

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Brass gold covers ≤10% of any screen — actions, active states, the key figure. Its rarity is the point; a second accent is never added.

rules.name: The Serif Is for Figures Rule
rules.body: Fraunces never renders body copy, buttons, or navigation — only numerals and the greeting.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A card at rest has no shadow. Elevation is earned by floating chrome or a featured status card only.

dos: Do render every numeric value in Fraunces.
Do keep brass gold to actions, active states, and the key figure.
Do separate sections with overline labels and hairlines, not nested cards.
Do express status as small-caps text tags on soft washes.
donts: Don't place a kicker/eyebrow above a heading; the wordmark is identity.
Don't use gradients — text or surfaces.
Don't stack icon chips with headings inside a card.
Don't use rings, sparklines, or figures as decoration — data only.
Don't ship UI requiring a new native dependency; stay pure-RN for OTA.
